item.title: 自定义层
item.author: 泡面zz
item.description: 不带参数的层 import torch import torch.nn.functional as F from torch import nn class CenteredLayer(nn.Module): def __init__(self): super().__init__() def forward(self, X): return X - X.mean() 带参数的层 class MyLinear(nn.Module): def __init__(self, in_units, units): super().__init__() self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(in_units, units)) self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(units,)) def forward(self, X): linear = torch.matmul(X, self.weight.data) + self.bias.data return F.relu(linear) 注意使用nn.Param
